items.title: Relationship between dynamic equilibrium and vapor pressure (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Relationship between dynamic equilibrium and vapor pressure: a main subheading of 8.4 Dynamic equilibrium between two physical states, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 170-171.

blocks.text: Liquids aur un ke vapour pressure (bhaap ka dabao) ko samajhna chemistry ka aham hissa hai. Jab liquid ko band container mein rakha jaye to satah (surface) ke qareeb kuch molecules ke paas itni energy hoti hai ke woh gas phase mein nikal jate hain. Is process ko evaporation (bhaap banna) kehte hain. Jitne zyada molecules gas mein jate hain, container ki deewaron par gas molecules ka pressure utna barhta hai. Saath hi bhaap ke molecules liquid ki satah se takra kar dobara liquid mein pakre bhi jate hain; is process ko condensation (bhaap ka wapas liquid banna) kehte hain.

Evaporation aur condensation chalte rehte hain aur aakhir kar dono ki rate barabar ho jati hai; yeh dynamic equilibrium ki halat hai. Is halat mein jitne liquid molecules gas bante hain, utne hi gas molecules wapas liquid mein aate hain. Dynamic equilibrium par kisi diye gaye temperature par vapour pressure constant rehta hai, jab tak system ko disturb (chheda) na kiya jaye.

Temperature barhne se liquid molecules ki average kinetic energy (harkat ki energy) barhti hai. Is se evaporation tez hota hai aur vapour pressure barhta hai. Zyada temperature par condensation ki rate bhi barhti hai. Aakhir system ek naye dynamic equilibrium par pohanchta hai jahan equilibrium vapour pressure pehle se zyada hota hai. In short (mukhtasar yeh ke) liquid ke vapour pressure ke hisaab se dynamic equilibrium woh halat hai jahan evaporation aur condensation ki rates barabar hon.

blocks.prompt: a) 100 °C par pani aur us ki bhaap ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium hai. Is statement ko justify (daleel se sabit) karein.
blocks.explanation: Band container mein 100 °C par pani ek rate se evaporate hota hai aur bhaap usi rate se condense hoti hai. Molecules satah ke dono taraf aate jate rehte hain, magar vapour pressure constant (1 atm) rehta hai. Rates barabar aur harkat jari: yahi dynamic equilibrium hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Kya 0 °C par barf aur pani ke darmiyan dynamic equilibrium hai? Agar haan, to explain karein.
blocks.explanation: Haan. 0 °C par barf ek rate se pighalti hai aur pani usi rate se jamta hai, is liye barf aur pani ki amount (miqdar) constant rehti hai, halanke alag alag molecules state badalte rehte hain.

items: Dynamic equilibrium: dono taraf barabar rate se tabdeeli, net change zero.
Band container mein evaporation = condensation; vapour pressure constant rehta hai.
Temperature barhe to naya equilibrium zyada vapour pressure par banta hai.
